files.time_unit: seconds according to thesis context; axis unit not printed
files.unit_notes: Disturbance-axis units are not printed. The text adds d to dot p1; do not label the amplitudes as motor forces in newtons without implementation evidence. Graphical reading suggests +3 during 10–10.5 s, +5 during 15–16 s, and −12 during 20–20.5 s. These are finite rectangular pulses, not Dirac impulses.
files.caption: The three signed finite-duration disturbance pulses used in the recorded 0–50 s test.

files.unit_notes: The displayed signal is labelled Hd with no energy unit. It tends toward zero despite a nonzero minimum of the written unshifted Vd formula, so an offset/diagnostic convention needs verification. Do not label it absolute physical energy in joules. Visible transient rises mean its decay is not monotonic.
files.caption: Recorded desired-energy diagnostic over 0–10 s, showing overall decay with transient rises.
